data.standardized_narrative: The balance sheet (Statement of Financial Position) shows gross claims outstanding at the prior-year comparative (31 December 2017) of US$4,132.9m. The report does not present an explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure that could be unambiguously extracted from the scanned pages. A claims development table appears in the notes but it is presented on a net basis (not gross) in the available images, so a gross prioryear development number could not be determined from the provided pages.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding located on the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior-year comparative column = 4,132.9). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) could be identified in the scanned notes. A claims development table exists in the report images but is labelled as 'net' (estimate of cumulative net incurred claims) and therefore was not used as the primary gross source. The P&L contains 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' lines (these are P&L claims incurred figures and NOT prior-year reserve movements) and were ignored per instructions. Segmental gross premium breakdown (regulatory class names) was not legible / not found in the provided images; gross written premium total taken from income/summary tables. Several pages were low-resolution/rotated making detailed extraction of notes and triangles unreliable; many fields are therefore null. If higher-resolution, correctly oriented scans of the technical reserves notes and the claims development table (gross) are provided, a gross prior-year development figure may be computed.
